recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed unless a future build or link checker produces a new lower-case Quantity fragment that lacks a matching canonical target.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core STU3 change request asking for useful anchors on Quantity specializations and constraints such as Age, Distance, SimpleQuantity, Duration, Count, and Money under datatypes.html Defined Variations on Quantity.
initial_application: Jira records svn revision 12618 as the fix. Git commit 3c0c1b50ccc0a1ed836669729337090a8fb9851a appears to be the application, changing stale ElementDefinition links from datatypes.html#duration to datatypes.html#Duration.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists the Quantity-related datatypes and maps the default datatype page to datatypes.html. The same investigation found FHIR-12805, an earlier same-family Published issue about lower-case generated allTypes diagram links to Quantity specializations.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/datatypes.html already has anchors for Distance, Age, Count, Duration, SimpleQuantity, and Money, and current-source grep found no remaining lower-case datatypes.html#duration-style links for these Quantity types.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published issue about lower-case generated diagram links to Duration and other Quantity specializations.
